gloss: memo paper; note paper; scratch paper

definitions.gloss: memo paper; note paper; scratch paper
definitions.explanation: Small sheets of paper used for jotting down notes, reminders, or memos.

examples.japanese: メモ{用紙|ようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote the phone number on a piece of memo paper.

examples.japanese: メモ{用紙|ようし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れて→切れる：01936_kireru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I've run out of memo paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}{中|ちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいたこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧メモ{用紙|ようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{留|と}めた→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧。
examples.english: I jotted down what I noticed during the meeting on a sheet of memo paper.

notes:
Composed of ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ (memo, from English) + ⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧ (paper for a specific use).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メモ{用紙|ようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write on memo paper
- メモ{用紙|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over a memo sheet
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧メモ{用紙|ようし}: a single sheet of memo paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付箋|ふせん}→付箋：08245_fusen⟧: sticky note — has an adhesive strip, whereas メモ{用紙|ようし} is plain paper.
